proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: Full review 2026-11-21. lean.ref QOU.BraidsAndKnots.markovWeights_eq_jones_of_fibre_categorical (lean/QOU/BraidsAndKnots/FibreCategoricalTraceForcesJones.lean:214) genuinely encodes part (ii) at n=3: from the class MassTraceIsFibreCategorical (row-cap support + faithfulness fields, which mention neither q, z nor convention D, so not self-assuming), hN : N = 2, and the three Markov equations on 1, s0, s0s1, it DERIVES [2]^2 y_(2,1) = 1, y_(3) = 1 - 2 y_(2,1), z [2] = q^2 via markovWeights_eq_jones_of_threeRow_eq_zero (sorry-free, division-free, generic domain). This matches the Selection theorem's computational core and the md's own status line. What the ref does NOT encode: part (i) uniqueness of the Markov trace at fixed z on the whole tower (the Iwahori-basis induction); part (iii) that the radical of the trace form is exactly the Temperley-Lieb ideal I_n for all n (QBeta/TemperleyLiebTower.lean has only n=3,4 dimension counts and convention-D antisymmetriser lemmas); the Selection theorem conclusion tau = tr_M at every level on all of H_n (the Lean concludes only the level-3 weights and z); and the general-n closed form y_(n-k,k) = [n-2k+1]/[2]^n, which the md itself says is numerically verified for n <= 7 and not proved by induction. The md calls (i) and (iii) unconditional, but they have no Lean statement here. Convention D throughout; no ruling conflict; no empirical input in the claim.

Re-read at 68ebfb21a05: Lean ref markovWeights_eq_jones_of_fibre_categorical unchanged; it encodes part (ii) at n=3 (derives [2]^2 y_(2,1)=1, y_(3)=1-2y_(2,1), z[2]=q^2). Not encoded: (i) uniqueness at fixed z on the tower, (iii) radical = TL ideal for all n, tau = tr_M at every level, the general-n closed form, and now the added dim TL_n = Catalan(n) claim (TemperleyLiebTower.lean has n=3,4 dimension counts only).
